metadata.description: mailglow — vibe-code beautiful, responsive HTML emails with your AI agent: a skill plus a zero-dependency local inbox to preview, lint for Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail, compare variants and screenshot every email.

plugins.name: mailglow
plugins.description: One skill + engine for designing HTML emails like screens: a local mini inbox (list + opened message, desktop/mobile, light/dark/forced-dark, images off), a client-compatibility linter (hosted images only, Gmail clipping, Outlook-safe layout), a variant switcher with Pick + notes the agent reads back, and headless-Chrome screenshots of every email. Zero dependencies, Node 22+.
